---
title: "Overview of Ecosystem Service: Water Quality"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    standalone: true
---

Water quality, or water purification, is valued as the nutrient retention ecosystems provide,
priced at what it would cost to treat the same load. Two nutrients are carried, nitrogen and
phosphorus, for the base year 2019. The price convention recorded in `es_config.csv` reads
`treatment cost (intl dollars question open)`, which names the open item on the currency below.

## Quantity

Retained nutrient in kilograms, restricted to the share of water that reaches domestic use:

$$
\text{EstimatedRetention (kg)} = \text{TotalRetention (kg)} \times \text{DomesticWaterUseFraction}
$$

The domestic-water-use fraction is the AQUASTAT share. The total retention figures come from an
NDR-style estimation upstream.

## Price

The treatment cost per kg of the nutrient, the committed table's `<nutrient>_Price(usd)`
column.

## Valuation

$$
\text{ServiceValue (USD)} = \text{EstimatedRetention (kg)} \times \text{Price (USD/kg)}
$$

`element_service_values` recomputes both identities per nutrient and compares them against the
committed columns at rtol 1e-9, raising if either breaks. `water_quality_gep_by_country` sums the
two nutrients into `water_quality_gep_usd` and joins the result onto the country list, then
attaches the committed international-dollar column beside it.

## Inputs

From `es_parameters.csv`, scoped to the `water_quality` service:

- `water_quality_retention_path`, the per-country retention estimates carrying the total
  retention, the domestic-water-use fraction, the prices and the committed intermediate columns
  the recomputation is checked against.
- `water_quality_international_path`, the final accounting table in international dollars.

## Output

`gep_calculation` writes `gep_by_country_base_year.csv` into its own task directory, holding the
r250 identifiers and attributes, `year`, `nitrogen_gep_usd`, `phosphorus_gep_usd`,
`water_quality_gep_usd` and `water_quality_gep`. Both totals are logged, the market-USD sum and
the international-dollar sum.

## Method constants

`WATER_QUALITY_NUTRIENTS = ('n', 'p')` names the two nutrients and drives the column lookups.

## Taken as given

The retention totals themselves. The folder carries the committed calculation but no script, so the
NDR-style estimation behind `TotalRetention(kg)` is adopted as produced.

## What is open

The final accounting output is expressed in 2019 international dollars, per the drive's method
note, and that conversion stage is not identified. It is not the plain sum of the USD components,
with per-country ratios reaching about 11 times. The single-factor XR over PPP hypothesis was
tested against the WDI series and rejected, missing by a median of 36 percent. The harmonisation
appears to use per-source-year cost inputs the folder does not carry. The committed
international-dollar values are therefore carried as the provisional account column, and the
conversion script with its inputs is the ask.

This also raises a cross-cutting question flagged on the deck. Every other service in the account
values in 2019 market USD.
